title: Admit current-day activity while retaining historical cost evidence
steps: Migrate unmatched legacy aggregate holds once without changing reservation receipts
Calculate current UTC dispatch-day commitment for world and entity caps
Reserve a fresh current-day estimate before model, evaluation or maintenance dispatch
Attribute later measured settlement to the original reservation day
Retain historical outstanding liabilities and conservative residuals across restart and restore
expectedOutcomes: New daily capacity excludes dated prior-day commitments
Unknown or undated liabilities remain visible and conservative
Reusing a prior-day reservation cannot authorise a fresh action
Evaluation and maintenance do not create a separate spending pool
Restore preserves current caps and cannot reset or multiply saved liabilities
